report_title: Source Audit Review Corrections & Policy Finalization

corrections_summary.bht25_suitability: Updated from SUITABLE to SUITABLE WITH CONDITIONS (quality metric 75.8% comes from a 500-sample human validation, not all 27,149 rows; 100% human review required)
corrections_summary.bht25_authorship: Corrected citation to include Vineeth Kumar: Sudeshna Sani, Suryakanth V. Gangashetty, Samudravijaya K, Anik Nandi, Aruna Priya, Vineeth Kumar, and Akhilesh Kumar Dubey (Data in Brief 2026, DOI: 10.1016/j.dib.2026.112775)
corrections_summary.bht25_redistribution: Clarified as permitted subject to CC BY 4.0 attribution and notice terms, not unrestricted
corrections_summary.sharealike_analysis: Refined Mozilla Telugu CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 analysis distinguishing Adapted Material (Section 1(a)) from Collections/Compilations (Section 1(b)) under official CC FAQ guidance. Removed blanket 'viral' terminology
corrections_summary.non_commercial_scope: Clarified that academic status does not automatically prove non-commercial use; applied official CC definition; institutional review recommended
corrections_summary.mozilla_common_voice: Noted concurrent presence of CC0 and no-rehosting clause; avoided asserting a settled legal contradiction; classified strictly as REFERENCE ONLY
corrections_summary.provenance_taxonomy: Added distinct licensed_corpus_extraction method alongside naturally_occurring, human_elicited, and parallel_reference. Barred public extraction from being labeled elicitation
corrections_summary.provenance_schema_blueprint: Standardized canonical spelling to license; kept top-level source_record_id canonical; added source_group_id, language_switch_count, language_token_counts; separated rights, consent, and review status
corrections_summary.split_policy: Formalized disjoint group splitting (document/chapter for corpus extraction; contributor disjointness across train and test for elicitation)
corrections_summary.code_mixing_inclusion_rule: Revised minimum threshold to at least one unambiguous lexical token per required language (excluding NE, punctuation, and mixed tokens); tracking switch counts
corrections_summary.workload_estimates: Removed unsupported projections (125, 135, 150 drafts); replaced with empirical small-pilot protocol (10 sentences/category) to calculate actual acceptance rates
corrections_summary.sample_inspection_evidence: Confirmed exactly 20 sample triplets streamed from BHT25 via public API; zero rows downloaded from other corpora; zero gated access attempted for LTRC

provenance_taxonomy.licensed_corpus_extraction: A sentence selected directly from an existing licensed corpus, with original record ID, document source, and license preserved. Subject to 100% human review.
provenance_taxonomy.naturally_occurring: An authentic utterance collected from organic discourse with appropriate permission and platform-rule compliance.
provenance_taxonomy.human_elicited: An original sentence deliberately authored by a contributor in response to a scenario.
provenance_taxonomy.parallel_reference: A human-authored mixed sentence composed with a parallel corpus as a semantic reference. Track reference source and attribution.
provenance_taxonomy.automatically_generated: Not eligible as ground-truth data in this project.

BHT25.rationale: CC BY 4.0; 27,149 triplets (sample validation 75.8%); requires 100% human review; parallel sentences must NOT be concatenated.

Mozilla_Telugu_Text.rationale: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 requires isolating NC-SA text and legal review before redistribution.

Mozilla_Common_Voice_Telugu.rationale: Page presents both CC0 and no-rehosting clause; 98.1% unvalidated; await clarification from Mozilla; zero records copied.

The_LTRC_Hindi_Telugu_Corpus.rationale: Gated on Hugging Face; access requires sharing account info; not downloaded. Parallel corpus, not code-mixed.

IndicLID_Training_Archives.rationale: FastText sentence-level format without token boundaries; web crawl licensing unverified.

Bhasha_Abhijnaanam_Benchmark.rationale: External evaluation benchmark only. Barred from candidate/training curation to prevent data leakage.

AI4Bharat_IndicCorp_Telugu.rationale: Web-scraped corpus with no clear data license declared on public page.

Human_Authored_Elicitation.rationale: Natural, token-level code-mixed data in native Telugu is absent from all public corpora.
